scripts.gateway:build: tsc -b && tsc --project gateway/tsconfig.json && vite build --mode pilot && node scripts/check_bundle_budget.mjs
scripts.verify:reader: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/reader --exclude "src/reader/pdf/**" --exclude "src/reader/pdf-reading/**"
scripts.verify:pdf: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/reader/pdf src/documents/pdf
scripts.verify:import: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/documents --exclude "src/documents/pdf/**" --exclude "src/documents/offline*"
scripts.verify:lookup: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/lookup src/components/LookupBottomSheet src/components/dictionaryDisplay src/components/lookupPopupPlacement --exclude "src/lookup/normalization/**" --exclude "**/*.offline.test.tsx"
scripts.verify:language: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/core/language src/lookup/normalization
scripts.verify:translation: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/core/translation src/core/context src/core/cache src/core/diagnostics src/core/performance src/ai src/settings src/integration gateway
scripts.verify:storage: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/db src/storage src/notes/store src/vocabulary
scripts.verify:ui: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/components src/onboarding src/app src/notes/NotesPanel --exclude "**/LookupBottomSheet*" --exclude "**/OfflineBadge*" --exclude "**/dictionaryDisplay*" --exclude "**/lookupPopupPlacement*"
scripts.verify:offline: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/documents/offline src/components/OfflineBadge src/components/LookupBottomSheet.offline
scripts.verify:full: npm run typecheck && vitest run && npm run build
